name: Add an Access application
description: Add an Access application Adds a new application to Access. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps
Adds a new application to Access.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete an Access application
description: Delete an Access application Deletes an application from Access. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}

name: Get an Access application
description: Get an Access application Fetches information about an Access application. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}

name: List Access applications
description: List Access applications Lists all Access applications in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps
Lists all Access applications in an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); domain (query); aud (query); target_attributes (query); exact (query); search (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Update Access application settings
description: Update Access application settings Updates Access application settings. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/settings
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/settings
Updates Access application settings.
Required: app_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: Update Access application settings
description: Update Access application settings Updates Access application settings. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/settings
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/settings
Updates Access application settings.
Required: app_id (path); account_id (path); body (body)

name: Revoke application tokens
description: Revoke application tokens Revokes all tokens issued for an application. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/revoke_tokens
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/revoke_tokens
Revokes all tokens issued for an application.
Required: app_id (path); account_id (path)

name: Test Access policies
description: Test Access policies Tests if a specific user has permission to access an application. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/user_policy_checks
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/user_policy_checks
Tests if a specific user has permission to access an application.
Required: app_id (path); account_id (path)

name: Update an Access application
description: Update an Access application Updates an Access application. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}

name: Convert an Access application policy to a reusable policy
description: Convert an Access application policy to a reusable policy Converts an application-scoped policy to a reusable policy. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies/{policy_id}/make_reusable
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies/{policy_id}/make_reusable
Converts an application-scoped policy to a reusable policy. The policy will no longer be exclusively scoped to the application. Further updates to the policy should go through the /accounts/{account_id}/policies/{uid} endpoint.
Required: app_id (path) — The application ID.; policy_id (path) — The policy ID.; account_id (path)

name: Create an Access application policy
description: Create an Access application policy Creates a policy applying exclusive to a single application that defines the users or groups who can reach it. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies
Creates a policy applying exclusive to a single application that defines the users or groups who can reach it. We recommend creating a reusable policy instead and subsequently referencing its ID in the application's 'policies' array.
Required: app_id (path) — The application ID.; account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete an Access application policy
description: Delete an Access application policy Deletes an Access policy specific to an application. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies/{policy_id}

name: Get an Access application policy
description: Get an Access application policy Fetches a single Access policy configured for an application. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies/{policy_id}

name: List Access application policies
description: List Access application policies Lists Access policies configured for an application. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies
Lists Access policies configured for an application. Returns both exclusively scoped and reusable policies used by the application.
Required: app_id (path) — The application ID.; account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query)

name: Update an Access application policy
description: Update an Access application policy Updates an Access policy specific to an application. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/policies/{policy_id}

POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/ca
Generates a new short-lived certificate CA and public key.

context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps/{app_id}/ca
Fetches a short-lived certificate CA and its public key.
Required: app_id (path); account_id (path)

name: List short-lived certificate CAs
